content: This page is designed to provide a detailed and systematic list of all commonly known inorganic and organometallic compounds for each chemical element. The compounds are organized alphabetically by the name of the chemical element rather than by their symbols. This approach ensures clarity and ease of reference. The list includes compounds that may merit their own dedicated pages, whether or not such pages currently exist. Users are encouraged to add any compounds that have been omitted or newly discovered to both this list and any related lists. For example, the following are some of the compounds listed under specific elements: 1. Boron (B): Tetrahydrofuran (THF) Sodium tetraborate decahydrate (Na₂B₄O₇·10H₂O) Borazine (B₃N₃H₆) Boric acid (H₃BO₃) Boron carbide (B₄C) Boron nitride (BN) Boron trioxide (B₂O₃) Boron suboxide (B₆O) Boron tribromide (BBr₃) Boron trichloride (BCl₃) Boron trifluoride (BF₃) Decaborane (B₁₀H₁₄) Diborane (B₂H₆) Lithium borohydride (LiBH₄) Sodium borohydride (NaBH₄) 2. Bromine (Br): Aluminum bromide (AlBr₃) Ammonium bromide (NH₄Br) Bromine trifluoride (BrF₃) Bromine pentafluoride (BrF₅) Calcium bromide (CaBr₂) Copper(I) bromide (CuBr) Copper(II) bromide (CuBr₂) Hydrobromic acid (HBr, aqueous and gaseous forms) Iron(II) bromide (FeBr₂) Iron(III) bromide (FeBr₃) Potassium bromide (KBr) Silver bromide (AgBr) Sodium bromide (NaBr) 3. Cadmium (Cd): Cadmium arsenide (Cd₃As₂) Cadmium bromide (CdBr₂) Cadmium carbonate (CdCO₃) Cadmium chloride (CdCl₂) Cadmium fluoride (CdF₂) Cadmium iodide (CdI₂) Cadmium oxide (CdO) Cadmium sulfide (CdS) Cadmium sulfate (CdSO₄) Cadmium telluride (CdTe) 4. Calcium (Ca): Calcium acetate (Ca(OCOCH₃)₂) Calcium bicarbonate (Ca(HCO₃)₂) Calcium boride (CaB₆) Calcium bromide (CaBr₂) Calcium carbide (CaC₂) Calcium carbonate (CaCO₃) Calcium chloride (CaCl₂) Calcium fluoride (CaF₂) Calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)₂) Calcium nitrate (Ca(NO₃)₂) Calcium oxide (CaO) Calcium sulfate (CaSO₄) 5. Carbon (C): Ammonium bicarbonate (NH₄HCO₃) Urea (NH₂CONH₂) Carbon dioxide (CO₂) Carbon monoxide (CO) Carbon disulfide (CS₂) Graphitic carbon nitride (β-C₃N₄) Carbon tetrachloride (CCl₄) Carbon tetrafluoride (CF₄) Phosgene (COCl₂) 6. Chlorine (Cl): Aluminum chloride (AlCl₃) Ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl) Antimony trichloride (SbCl₃) Barium chloride (BaCl₂) Boron trichloride (BCl₃) Carbon tetrachloride (CCl₄) Chlorine dioxide (ClO₂) Chlorine trifluoride (ClF₃) Hydrochloric acid (HCl, aqueous and gaseous forms) Sodium chloride (NaCl) 7. Fluorine (F): Aluminum fluoride (AlF₃) Ammonium fluoride (NH₄F) Antimony pentafluoride (SbF₅) Boron trifluoride (BF₃) Calcium fluoride (CaF₂) Carbon tetrafluoride (CF₄) Hydrogen fluoride (HF, aqueous and gaseous forms) Potassium fluoride (KF) Sodium fluoride (NaF) Sulfur hexafluoride (SF₆) 8. Hydrogen (H): Ammonia (NH₃) Boric acid (H₃BO₃) Hydrobromic acid (HBr) Hydrochloric acid (HCl) Hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) Hydrogen sulfide (H₂S) Lithium aluminum hydride (LiAlH₄) Sodium borohydride (NaBH₄) 9. Iron (Fe): Iron(II) chloride (FeCl₂) Iron(III) chloride (FeCl₃) Iron(II) sulfate (FeSO₄) Iron(III) sulfate (Fe₂(SO₄)₃) Iron(II) oxide (FeO) Iron(III) oxide (Fe₂O₃) Magnetite (Fe₃O₄) 10. Oxygen (O): Aluminum oxide (Al₂O₃) Carbon dioxide (CO₂) Carbon monoxide (CO) Chromium trioxide (CrO₃) Iron(III) oxide (Fe₂O₃) Magnesium oxide (MgO) Sodium oxide (Na₂O) This list is not exhaustive and is continually updated to include newly discovered compounds or those that may have been previously omitted. Each compound is categorized under its respective element for clarity and ease of access.
